harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established a file-integrity baseline for /etc on node1 (Alpine Linux 3.23, no AIDE/tripwire package available in repos) using a custom BusyBox-compatible script at /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity.sh, backed by SHA-256 checksums and metadata (perms/owner/size/mtime) for all 277 files under /etc, stored in /var/lib/file-integrity/. Verified detection works by modifying /etc/motd and adding a new file — both were correctly flagged — then reverted and regenerated a clean baseline. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol: captured pre-restart boot_id, rebooted node1 via `reboot`, polled until reconnection, and confirmed a new boot_id plus intact baseline files and a clean verify run post-restart.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 OS (Alpine 3.23.3) and searched apk repos for aide/tripwire/samhain/osquery — none available
Confirmed find/sha256sum/stat/xargs/comm/awk are present (BusyBox v1.37.0)
Created /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity.sh implementing generate/verify subcommands using sha256sum manifest + stat-based metadata snapshot
Ran 'generate' to produce baseline files in /var/lib/file-integrity (etc-baseline.sha256, etc-baseline.meta, etc-integrity.log)
Ran 'verify' on clean state confirming no diffs
Falsification test: appended to /etc/motd and created /etc/newly-added-test-file, ran verify, confirmed both changes detected (motd FAILED checksum, new file listed)
Reverted test changes and regenerated a clean baseline
Captured pre-restart boot_id (15f3a3af...) and baseline file hashes as healthy baseline
Triggered native reboot via backgrounded 'sleep 2; reboot' so acknowledgement returned before disconnect
Polled node1 until reconnected; confirmed new boot_id (c10061fb...) and low uptime (31.88s) proving actual restart
Re-verified baseline files present with identical SHA-256 hashes post-restart and ran verify showing no changes to /etc

evidence.requirement: Alpine repos lack a dedicated integrity tool (AIDE/tripwire/etc), justifying custom script
evidence.summary: os-release shows Alpine 3.23.3; apk add aide fails (no such package); apk search finds no aide/tripwire/samhain packages

evidence.requirement: Baseline generation script created and functional
evidence.summary: Diagnosed missing /usr/local/sbin and BusyBox find lacking -printf, adapted script to use stat -c, wrote /usr/local/sbin/etc-integrity.sh, and ran it successfully to generate the baseline

evidence.requirement: Baseline covers all files in /etc with integrity data, and verify works on clean state
evidence.summary: 277 files hashed (etc-baseline.sha256) and 377 metadata entries (etc-baseline.meta); verify run shows zero checksum diffs and zero new files

evidence.requirement: Baseline actually detects later changes to /etc (core task requirement)
evidence.summary: After appending to /etc/motd and adding /etc/newly-added-test-file, verify correctly reported './motd: FAILED' and listed the new file as untracked

evidence.requirement: Clean baseline restored after falsification test
evidence.summary: Reverted test changes, regenerated baseline, verify shows no differences and no new files

evidence.requirement: node1 healthy baseline captured before restart
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 15f3a3af-5dc2-4277-95c5-0d058638800c, uptime 81.24s, and confirmed baseline files present with sha256sums and clean verify output

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect
evidence.summary: Backgrounded 'sleep 2; reboot' returned pid immediately; subsequent poll still showed original boot_id/rising uptime confirming the exec call didn't block on the reboot itself

evidence.requirement: node1 boot identity changed after restart (proof of actual restart, not just elapsed time)
evidence.summary: Post-reconnect boot_id is c10061fb-7520-49b2-8408-39b8e1e669a6 (different from pre-restart 15f3a3af...) with uptime reset to 31.88s

evidence.requirement: node1 required data (integrity baseline) recovered/persisted after restart
evidence.summary: Baseline files still present post-restart with identical SHA-256 hashes to pre-restart capture, and verify still reports zero /etc changes
